description: One exhaustive authority entry per method. Anything not listed is denied. Generated from crates/kr-protocol; do not edit by hand.

methods.name: host.info
methods.summary: Host build identity, protocol limits and configured services.

methods.name: environment.list
methods.summary: The environments this actor's grant admits.

methods.name: environment.capabilities
methods.summary: What one environment can currently do. Capability evidence, never authority.

methods.name: host.doctor
methods.summary: Host diagnostics with credentials redacted.

methods.name: pair.invite
methods.summary: Issue a five-minute single-use pairing invitation in code or direct mode.

methods.name: pair.redeem
methods.summary: Redeem an invitation from the bounded pre-authorisation surface.

methods.name: pair.finish
methods.summary: Bind the pairing transcript to the live iroh endpoint identities.

methods.name: pair.confirm
methods.summary: Commit the device record and its grant after owner approval.

methods.name: pair.cancel
methods.summary: Consume an invitation without issuing a grant.

methods.name: pair.status
methods.summary: Report a pending or committed pairing result, never secret material.

methods.name: device.list
methods.summary: Paired devices, their key purposes and each host's last authority acknowledgement.

methods.name: device.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a device. Completion requires the per-worker dispatch barrier, not a lease timer.

methods.name: device.preview_key.update
methods.summary: Rotate this device's own notification-preview key through its paired proof.

methods.name: catalogue.list
methods.summary: Configured plugin catalogues, their roots, generations and budgets.

methods.name: catalogue.add
methods.summary: Trust a new catalogue root. A new root always requires fresh owner confirmation.

methods.name: catalogue.sync
methods.summary: Synchronise a catalogue generation within its verified trust ceiling.

methods.name: catalogue.pin
methods.summary: Pin a catalogue to an exact generation.

methods.name: catalogue.remove
methods.summary: Remove a catalogue and stop trusting its root.

methods.name: plugin.list
methods.summary: Installed plugins, their pinned packages and their enabled state.

methods.name: plugin.install
methods.summary: Install a verified package inside the repository's trust ceiling.

methods.name: plugin.remove
methods.summary: Remove an installed plugin from an environment.

methods.name: plugin.pin
methods.summary: Pin a plugin to an exact package hash.

methods.name: plugin.enable
methods.summary: Enable an installed plugin in an environment.

methods.name: plugin.disable
methods.summary: Disable an installed plugin without removing it.

methods.name: plugin.grant
methods.summary: Grant a plugin capability. Executable and native-bridge capabilities need confirmation.

methods.name: plugin.capabilities
methods.summary: What one installed plugin can currently do under its verified package.

methods.name: plugin.action.invoke
methods.summary: Invoke a registered plugin action. Its own entry adds the rights this call intersects.

methods.name: question.create
methods.summary: Create a question from a verified originating application. Source ownership never impersonates a human answer or chooses an ungranted destination.

methods.name: question.read_own
methods.summary: Read the questions this source created.

methods.name: question.cancel_own
methods.summary: Cancel a question this source created.

methods.name: alert.create
methods.summary: Raise an alert from a verified originating application.

methods.name: question.read
methods.summary: Read questions this actor may see, at their exact current revision.

methods.name: question.answer
methods.summary: Answer the exact question revision shown, resolved atomically.

methods.name: question.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel the exact question revision shown, resolved atomically.

methods.name: agent_tools.install
methods.summary: Install the contact skill for a target agent under an exact change manifest.

methods.name: agent_tools.status
methods.summary: Report what is installed for a target agent, at which scope and version.

methods.name: agent_tools.remove
methods.summary: Remove the contact skill from a target agent under an exact change manifest.

methods.name: session.list
methods.summary: List the sessions this actor may observe.

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Create a session. Deduplication happens in the controller before a worker exists.

methods.name: session.read
methods.summary: Read one session's filtered metadata and current state.

methods.name: session.close
methods.summary: Close a session and hand its final metadata to the archive service.

methods.name: session.describe
methods.summary: An authorised read of filtered session metadata, not arbitrary model control.

methods.name: session.rename
methods.summary: Set a session's pinned label.

methods.name: session.attach
methods.summary: Attach in semantic or terminal mode. A geometry claim needs terminal.geometry as well.

methods.name: session.detach
methods.summary: Detach this actor's own attachment and run geometry succession.

methods.name: attachment.configure
methods.summary: Withdraw or add an authorised geometry claim without displacing the current owner.

methods.name: attachment.viewport
methods.summary: Report this attachment's physical dimensions. It never changes the pseudoterminal.

methods.name: terminal.resize
methods.summary: Resize the pseudoterminal. Only the current geometry owner at the current epoch may.

methods.name: terminal.geometry.transfer
methods.summary: Hand geometry ownership to another eligible attachment.

methods.name: terminal.palette.set
methods.summary: Set the session palette.

methods.name: input.acquire
methods.summary: Acquire the input lease explicitly. There is no implicit remote acquisition.

methods.name: input.release
methods.summary: Release the input lease this actor holds.

methods.name: input.interrupt
methods.summary: Send an interrupt under the current lease.

methods.name: input.write
methods.summary: Write ordered raw input under the current lease epoch and input sequence. Unsent or ambiguously delivered keystrokes are discarded, never replayed.

methods.name: root.editor.enter
methods.summary: The validated root process reports that its line editor is active.

methods.name: root.editor.leave
methods.summary: The validated root process reports that its line editor is no longer active.

methods.name: root.editor.fence
methods.summary: Advance the root editor fence so an intervening local edit is detected.

methods.name: root.eof.detach
methods.summary: The root shell reached end of file and the session detaches instead of exiting blindly.

methods.name: root.command.accepted
methods.summary: The root integration confirms that the installed command was accepted by the editor.

methods.name: shell.launch
methods.summary: Install and submit an argument vector or correctly quoted command through the trusted root editor. An intervening local edit returns DRAFT_CONFLICT.

methods.name: agent.capabilities
methods.summary: What the bound agent can currently do, with its capability evidence.

methods.name: agent.snapshot
methods.summary: A filtered snapshot of the bound agent's shared state.

methods.name: agent.commands
methods.summary: The commands the bound agent advertises.

methods.name: agent.prompt.submit
methods.summary: Submit a prompt. Applied means upstream admission, not task completion.

methods.name: agent.prompt.queue
methods.summary: Queue a prompt behind the current turn.

methods.name: agent.turn.steer
methods.summary: Steer the current turn where the upstream agent supports it.

methods.name: agent.turn.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel the current turn using its typed request and current turn identifier.

methods.name: agent.approval.respond
methods.summary: Answer an upstream approval request at its exact revision and pending state.

methods.name: draft.create
methods.summary: Create a device-owned draft that survives attachment replacement.

methods.name: draft.update
methods.summary: Update a draft at its exact revision. A draft is never submitted automatically.

methods.name: agent.draft.add_attachment
methods.summary: Insert a completed attachment handle into a draft through the active adapter.

methods.name: upload.begin
methods.summary: Reserve the declared size and return an upload identifier, chunk size and expiry.

methods.name: upload.status
methods.summary: Report verified chunk status so an interrupted transfer resumes without republishing.

methods.name: upload.chunk
methods.summary: Send one chunk with its index, exact length and digest. A matching duplicate is acknowledged; a conflicting duplicate invalidates the upload.

methods.name: upload.finish
methods.summary: Verify the declared digest and size, then publish the attachment handle atomically.

methods.name: upload.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel an unfinished upload and release its reservation.

methods.name: download.begin
methods.summary: Open an immutable source revision or bounded staging snapshot and describe its chunks.

methods.name: download.chunk
methods.summary: Read one chunk of the same snapshot. Read authority is checked on every request.

methods.name: project.list
methods.summary: List environment-local repositories as scoped metadata.

methods.name: project.read
methods.summary: Read one repository's scoped metadata.

methods.name: project.init
methods.summary: Initialise a repository at an authorised destination handle.

methods.name: project.clone
methods.summary: Clone into an authorised destination through the approved credential broker.

methods.name: project.adopt
methods.summary: Adopt an existing checkout through the explicit adoption flow.

methods.name: project.operation.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel owned repository work and report retained or removed staging paths.

methods.name: workspace.list
methods.summary: List workspaces. A view never implies deletion.

methods.name: workspace.create
methods.summary: Create a shared or isolated workspace with explicit inclusion rules.

methods.name: workspace.read
methods.summary: Read one workspace's policy and bound sessions.

methods.name: workspace.remove
methods.summary: Remove a workspace once its retention rules and pins permit it.

methods.name: diff.read
methods.summary: Read a diff with repository identity, base, head and content revisions.

methods.name: diff.apply
methods.summary: Apply a diff under the destination's concurrency contract. A preflight conflict returns DRAFT_CONFLICT without any write.

methods.name: diff.revert
methods.summary: Revert a previously applied change under the same destination contract.

methods.name: changeset.capture
methods.summary: Capture an immutable change-set version with its policy and provenance.

methods.name: changeset.read
methods.summary: Read one exact change-set version.

methods.name: changeset.materialize
methods.summary: Materialise an exact change-set version into an independent workspace.

methods.name: review.read
methods.summary: Read review state bound to exact change-set versions.

methods.name: review.acknowledge
methods.summary: Acknowledge review of one version. It affects only this actor and mutates no code.

methods.name: attention.read
methods.summary: Read the attention inbox for this actor's scope.

methods.name: attention.acknowledge
methods.summary: Acknowledge an attention item for this actor only.

methods.name: visit.acknowledge
methods.summary: Record this actor's visit so changed-since-last-visit stays per actor.

methods.name: action.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel an undispatched intent atomically. After a dispatch marker, cancellation is a separate upstream action with its own receipt.

methods.name: owner.confirmation.request
methods.summary: Start a confirmation ceremony bound to one single-use action digest.

methods.name: owner.confirmation.complete
methods.summary: Complete the ceremony with a protected user-verification context. A click that desktop automation can synthesise is not that proof.

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: Subscribe to an event stream from a cursor.

methods.name: events.snapshot
methods.summary: Take a filtered snapshot and the cursor it was taken at, after RESYNC_REQUIRED.

methods.name: history.page
methods.summary: Page retained history. A history request never creates a worker.

methods.name: action.read
methods.summary: Read a retained receipt. Owning the identifier is not enough: present view authority over the subject the receipt names is checked before it is returned, so a device that lost its scope cannot retrieve protected information through an old action identifier. A receipt for a host effect resolves against that host scope, not against a session.

methods.name: grant.create
methods.summary: Delegate a narrower grant. Persistent enlargement requires owner confirmation.

methods.name: grant.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a grant and its descendants. Completion uses the per-worker dispatch barrier.

methods.name: grant.list
methods.summary: List grants this issuer may see, with their revisions and expiry.

methods.name: push.installation.register
methods.summary: Bind a push token to an installation identity after the token-receipt challenge.

methods.name: push.sender.issue
methods.summary: Issue a host-scoped delivery credential for one installation.

methods.name: push.sender.renew
methods.summary: Renew a delivery credential without changing destination, host key or rate policy.

methods.name: push.sender.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a sender authorisation. A revoked record cannot renew.

methods.name: mailbox.read
methods.summary: Read encrypted mailbox envelopes. The service never sees their plaintext.

methods.name: mailbox.deliver
methods.summary: Place one sealed envelope in a recipient's mailbox. The service stores the routing record and the ciphertext and never a plaintext field.

methods.name: mailbox.acknowledge
methods.summary: Acknowledge mailbox items the recipient has stored durably, so the service may remove them. The replay identifiers outlive the items.

methods.name: authority.sync
methods.summary: Exchange signed revocation requests and host acknowledgements. Only the host issues its own ordered revisions, and it rejects an older revision.

methods.name: sync.compare_exchange
methods.summary: Publish encrypted settings or draft state under a compare-and-exchange generation.

methods.name: backup.manifest
methods.summary: Publish or fetch a backup generation manifest. Writer authority is verified.

methods.name: storage.status
methods.summary: Report what managed storage this principal holds, what is awaiting deletion and the retention the service applies to it.

methods.name: storage.retention.set
methods.summary: Turn managed backup storage on and set how many daily snapshots it keeps, within the bounds the service publishes. It is off until this is asked for.

methods.name: storage.upload.create
methods.summary: Reserve the declared maximum and allocate one random object key, upload identifier and immutable part table. No content is accepted before all of that exists.

methods.name: storage.upload.part
methods.summary: Upload one part. The service reads at most the declared length and refuses an oversized or wrong-hash body before it writes anything.

methods.name: storage.upload.complete
methods.summary: Complete the upload. The service verifies every part size and the total, settles the hold as stored bytes, and answers a repeat with the result it already gave.

methods.name: storage.upload.abort
methods.summary: Abandon the upload. New parts and completions are fenced first, then the stored state is removed, and the hold is given back only once that removal is confirmed.

methods.name: storage.object.read
methods.summary: Read a bounded range of one stored object's ciphertext. The service holds no key for it.

methods.name: storage.object.delete
methods.summary: Delete one stored object. It becomes a tombstone for the published window before the ciphertext is removed and the allowance released.

methods.name: voice.start
methods.summary: Start a voice session. Budget and account checks happen at the managed broker.

methods.name: voice.stop
methods.summary: Stop a voice session. Ending it revokes its voice grant immediately.

methods.name: voice.grant
methods.summary: Create or change a voice grant, stating exactly which actions it permits. A device may broaden its own; changing another device's needs host-management authority.

methods.name: voice.delegate
methods.summary: Submit a delegation from the paired device. A provider delegation identifier is correlation data, never authority.

methods.name: voice.context
methods.summary: Read the selected voice context. Selection intersects this device's scope and never uses the host owner's broader history.

methods.name: workflow.install
methods.summary: Install a versioned automation definition under an explicit workflow grant.

methods.name: workflow.enable
methods.summary: Enable an installed definition at an exact revision.

methods.name: workflow.pause
methods.summary: Pause a definition. Exceeding a concurrency or budget limit pauses it automatically.

methods.name: workflow.run
methods.summary: Start a run, recording the trigger event, definition version and causal parent.

methods.name: workflow.read
methods.summary: Read definitions, runs, node receipts and remaining causal budget.
